highlights.title: Every web filter on iPhone
highlights.detail: The iPhone app has the same filters as the web. The server computes the filtered totals.

highlights.title: Items, rules and bulk edits on iPhone
highlights.detail: The iPhone app has an Items tab, a Rules page and bulk edits in Activity.

highlights.title: Dashboard charts on iPhone
highlights.detail: Summary shows the spending chart by day, month or running total, grouped by merchant or category.
